title: Software Engineering Internship
summary: Learn how a software team builds and maintains web applications by working on small, well-scoped tasks with guidance and code review.
responsibilities: Implement small fixes and improvements with guidance from an engineer.
Test changes, document what you checked, and ask for feedback in code reviews.
requirements: Basic knowledge of one programming language and familiarity with HTML and CSS.
A coursework, personal, or practice project you can explain.
Willingness to learn Git, communicate when blocked, and act on feedback.
